title: Water Damage Mitigation Training Note: Vacuuming Where Moved Contents Stood
content:
**Training note — Water Damage Mitigation final cleaning**

Rooms whose contents were moved and blocked are vacuumed where the contents stood: on a Category 2 or Category 3 job carrying contents manipulation lines the vacuumed contents area on the final HEPA vacuuming line is 120 square feet for each room on those lines, on a Category 1 job carrying contents manipulation lines it is 60 square feet for each room, and in any other case no contents area is vacuumed under this rule.

## Questions answered
**How are the rooms counted?** By the rooms on the job's contents manipulation lines, that is the quantity those lines carry.

**Does the water category matter?** Yes. Contaminated water (Category 2 or Category 3) means 120 square feet per room; clean water (Category 1) means 60 square feet per room.

**A job with no contents manipulation line?** No contents area under this rule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contents manipulation lines for 3 rooms)
| Water category | Vacuumed contents area |
|---|---|
| Category 3 | 360 square feet |
| Category 2 | 360 square feet |
| Category 1 | 180 square feet |
